E4Plus1.uk.description: Can Star Trek fan Martin set his phaser to stun burlesque performer Susie? And can boxer Perry show hairdresser Bonnie his sensitive side? (S8 Ep3) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: What do the Goggleboxers think of Black Mirror, Gladiators and The Apprentice? Also, Britain's Got Talent, The Great Celebrity Bake Off for Stand Up To Cancer and Casualty. (S25 Ep9) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: This time it's Corrie, The Stolen Girl, The Piano, Mickey Rourke on Celebrity Big Brother, savoury cocktails on Saturday Kitchen, the News on Katy Perry in space, and more. (S25 Ep10) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: La Galleria 33 (Part 1/2): Gordon tries to help La Galleria 33, run by sisters Rita and Lisa, who blame the restaurant's failures on everything from tablecloths to the weather. (S6 Ep1) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Wet 'n' Wild Weymouth One: Leon wants to get wed on a beach in Weymouth. But bride-to-be Kirsty wants a fairy-tale day somewhere special to her.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks Omnibus
E4Plus1.uk.description: Everyone turns to Vicky for answers about the crash. Diane breaks the news of her prognosis to her family. Tensions rise between Sienna and Cleo. Warren and Jenson lock horns over Mercedes.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Undeck the Halls: Christmas is in full swing at the Dunphy house, until the kids get into trouble and Phil and Claire threaten to cancel Christmas unless one of them fesses up. (S1 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Up All Night: Gloria isn't happy with Jay's reaction to the arrival of Javier, Manny's infamously unreliable dad. Phil is suffering from kidney stones. (S1 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fifteen Percent: Mitchell seeks revenge when Jay introduces Cameron as just his 'friend'. Gloria gives Manny's date a makeover. (S1 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Casa Roma: Gordon visits Casa Roma, the oldest restaurant in Lancaster, California. Although the bar is a success, the restaurant is failing and has had 20 chefs in two years. (S2 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: La Galleria 33 (Part 2/2): The saga of Boston eatery La Galleria 33 comes to a dramatic conclusion as Gordon Ramsay gives restaurant owners and sisters Rita and Lisa an ultimatum. (S6 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The couples have met their alternate matches. But now it's time for the real carnage: getting them to watch videos of how their spouses behaved. (S13 Ep35)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The final dinner party is upon us, and one couple are on the brink after the tumult of meeting their alternate matches. (S13 Ep36)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Streetcar Named Marge: Homer's boorishness inspires Marge to give the performance of a lifetime in a musical version of A Streetcar Named Desire. (S4 Ep2/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Mook, the Chef, the Wife and Her Homer: Homer becomes the boss of Fat Tony's mob when Tony's son decides to become a chef rather than go into the family business. (S18 Ep1/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Moe 'n' a Lisa: Lisa discovers Moe's poetic talent and helps get him published. And he's so successful that he - and the Simpsons - are invited to a literary conference. (S18 Ep6/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Haw-Hawed Couple: Bart becomes Nelson's best friend when Marge makes him go to his birthday party. Which means no one can mess with Bart. But there are downsides too... (S18 Ep8/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Man from G.R.A.M.P.A.: A British secret agent comes to Springfield on the trail of a Russian spy. Guest starring Stephen Fry. (S32 Ep21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Last Barfighter: A secret society of bartenders seek vengeance on Homer and his friends after Moe breaks their most sacred rule. (S32 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: The Amazing Race Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Our teams clown around at the circus in Cambodia's second-largest city, Siem Reap. A fiddly floral task brings mud, sweat and tears. And one pair have a meltdown. (S7 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Titanic
E4Plus1.uk.description: (1997) Leonardo DiCaprio and Kate Winslet star in James Cameron's Oscar-winning epic. Lovers from across the social divide meet on the doomed luxury liner.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Copshop
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2021) Action thriller with Gerard Butler. A hitman gets himself arrested so that he can get to a bad guy, who also got himself arrested, so that he could hide from the hitman.
